dhcps4_renew_timer.description: Time in seconds after which a client may attempt to renew its lease.

dhcps4_rebind_timer.description: Time in seconds after which a client may attempt to rebind its lease if renewal fails.

dhcps4_max_lease_time.description: Maximum time in seconds a lease may be assigned.

dhcps4_lease_changes_interval.description: Interval in seconds between writes of lease changes to disk (0 = write on every change).

dhcps4_interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to listen on for DHCP requests.

dhcps4_control_socket_name.description: Unix socket path for Kea DHCPv4 control agent communication.

dhcps4_queue_capacity.description: Maximum number of incoming packets that may be queued when processing is delayed.

dhcps4_enable_queue.description: Enable packet queuing (recommended for high-load servers).

dhcps4_log_output.description: Path to log file for DHCPv4 server messages.

dhcps4_log_severity.description: Minimum severity level to log (DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, FATAL).

dhcps4_log_debuglevel.description: Debug level (0 = minimal, up to 99 for verbose debug).

dhcps4_shared_networks.description: List of DHCPv4 shared networks (each defines a subnet and related settings).

name.description: Unique name for the shared network.

pools.description: Range(s) of IP addresses to lease.

start.description: First IP address in the pool range.

end.description: Last IP address in the pool range.

option_data.description: Custom DHCP options to include for clients in this network.

data.description: Option data as string (e.g., comma-separated IPs).

reservations.description: Static DHCP reservations (fixed IPs for known MACs).

hostname.description: Hostname to assign to this client.

client_class.description: Optional client class restriction for this network (leave empty to allow all).

dhcps4_hosts_lfc_interval.description: Interval in seconds for automatic log-file compaction of the hosts database.

dhcps4_data_directory.description: Directory for persistent data (leases, hosts, etc.).
